question: Which A-list couple secretly got married without telling anyone?
story: Tom Holland just casually confirmed he secretly married Zendaya, and he did it in the most low key way possible. For years these two were Hollywood's most private couple, dodging every question about their relationship. According to a new Esquire cover story, Holland finally slipped up in the best way, mentioning that on their wedding day, their family members were all there. That one sentence sent fans into a total meltdown. The rumors actually started back in January, when Zendaya's longtime stylist Law Roach reportedly told a red carpet reporter that the wedding already happened, and that it was, quote, very true. The pair got engaged in December of 2024 after years together, most of it kept completely out of the spotlight. Now they are back on the Spider-Man press tour in Madrid, playing it cool like nothing happened. Turns out the two Spider-Man stars saved their biggest secret for real life.
